skills.name: shuo-ui
skills.description: Build forms, query pages and result lists with Shuo UI (@shuo/ui), a Nuxt module of form components built on Nuxt UI v4. Use when writing or editing Vue/Nuxt code that uses Shuo components (ShuoInputText, ShuoInputNumber, ShuoSelectMenu, ShuoDatepicker, ShuoQueryCard, ShuoListCard, ShuoTable and others), Shuo validation rules (requiredText, requiredNumber, requiredArray), or the shuoUi options in nuxt.config.ts.
